title: Painting Forsythia Flowers
content: I paint the flowers of a forsythia shrub using a limited palette of watercolor and gouache. I show how to start by capturing the overall gesture and silhouette of the whole plant and then subdivide the mass into smaller shapes.Full video on YouTubeART SUPPLIES:White gouacheCadmium yellowCerulean blueScarlet pyrrolBurnt siennaWater cupVIDEO TUTORIALS:“Watercolor in the Wild” (Download or stream on Gumroad)"Flower Painting in the Wild" (Gumroad):"Gouache in the Wild" (Gumroad)"Gouache in the Wild" on (DVD):“How to Make a Sketch Easel” (DVD)“Watercolor in the Wild” (Download)
